title: The deciding is the work — baby planning & the mental load (Reena, 33)
caption:
The deciding is the work: anticipate, weigh, decide, monitor. Couples split deciding; women carry the rest (Daminger, ASR 2019).
Send this to the friend with the 'maybe' spreadsheet. Which column is yours?

scenes.text: Reena is 33, with a rental, a full calendar, and a spreadsheet named maybe2027.
phrases: Sweet of him. But the clock was hers.
She'd been running it quietly for four years.

scenes.text: Couples split the deciding fairly evenly. The anticipating and the monitoring landed on her.
phrases: The actual decision? They talked that through together.
Thinking three years ahead about daycare, money, her job — that was hers alone.
So Reena wasn't being dramatic. She was carrying three of the four stages.

scenes.text: Tonight: four columns on paper, hand two of them over, then walk twenty minutes.
phrases: Write four columns: anticipate, weigh, decide, monitor.
Hand two of them over out loud tonight, not hinted at.
Then take a 20-minute walk — WHO asks adults for 150 minutes a week.
